title: The member-list import shows Google's AI real names from some columns, while the privacy notice says names are hidden
what: Before up to 5 example rows of a gym's old member file go to Google Gemini (or Claude), name and address columns are swapped for a placeholder. But a column whose heading holds a word such as trainer, coach, no, number, ID, code or from is always sent as it is, even when its cells are people's names. So a 'Trainer' column, a 'Father / Guardian name and contact no' column, an 'Emergency contact name (mobile no)' column or a 'Referred by member ID' column sends real names (mobiles stay masked). A free-text remarks column that does not look like a name or an address, such as 'BP patient since 2020', is also sent word for word, so health notes can go out. The server repeats the same rule, so it catches none of this. The privacy notice says names, addresses, mobiles, emails and ID numbers are hidden and only plan names, amounts and dates are not.
expected: No person's name and no health note from the file ever reaches the AI, whatever the column heading says; or the privacy notice says plainly which kinds of columns are sent as they are.
who: gym members, their family contacts and trainers named in an imported file
how_often: each AI import of a file with such a column
fix_line: Hide the cells of every column that is not a plan, amount, date or batch column, whatever its heading, or change the notice to say what is sent.

title: A diet plan sent to named members can never be deleted, though the gym terms say plans can be deleted at any time
what: A diet plan can be addressed to members by name and carries free-text notes from the trainer. The gym can only withdraw it: it stays on MettleUp's server for ever with the list of members it was sent to, also after those members leave the gym. The gym terms tell owners they can change, delete or add plans at any time.
expected: The gym can delete a diet plan for good, and a member's name comes off a plan when the member is removed from the gym.
who: gym owners and the members a plan was sent to
fix_line: Add a real delete for diet plans and drop removed members from a plan's list.

items.reason: 4 promises read. P-A7-panel-2-30 kept in code: the member app asks for gym timings every 10 minutes (no personal data; whether it asks while closed is left to lens 10). P-A7-panel-2-14 kept: the 'we haven't seen you' text has no offer in it. P-A7-panel-2-26 is a set-up hint with no personal data; nothing broken. P-A7-panel-2-31 kept: a detail that would make the record too big is left out and the row says so.

Data minimisation: Aadhaar and PAN columns are dropped and ID numbers are cut out of every imported cell (good). Children: the import takes any past birthday, so under-18 members come in the same way as by hand (existing FN-L4-panel-forms-01). Purpose: the import sample to the AI goes beyond what the notice says (finding 01). Deletion: diet plans cannot be deleted (finding 02).

MettleUp sees what the panel sends to the help box (the question, the browser, the page, and the device's sign-in key so the gym can be told apart and charged). The read log is kept on the server, not in this area. Inside the gym, the help list with the owner's questions and MettleUp's replies is kept per browser, so other staff on the same computer see it (existing FN-A5-panel-logic-1-3-03). Trainer questions: the owner does not see questions asked to another trainer (server rule).

E-feedback reader (Your questions): the browser keeps the last 30 questions, answers and replies with no age limit, longer than the 1 year the notice gives for help questions, and does not clear them at sign-out (folded into FN-A5-panel-logic-1-3-03). Workout reports: 30 days, as the notice says. Body measurements read here stay after the member is removed (existing FN-L4-panel-shop-01). Diet plans are kept for ever (finding 02).

Outside sends from this area: the member-list sample to Google Gemini or Claude (names leak through some columns, finding 01); help questions to Claude through the help box (matches the notice). No WhatsApp, analytics, Health Connect, Google Health or Fitbit calls in these files.

Help questions (E-feedback) are kept in the second database, which a gym delete does not reach (existing FN-L4-hq-app-05), and the browser copy survives sign-out and deletion (FN-A5-panel-logic-1-3-03). Body measurements stay after a member is removed (FN-L4-panel-shop-01). Diet plans can never be deleted (finding 02). A real delete was not run (live write). Backups: 7 days per the notice, not checkable from this area.
